final_ui_source_asset_proof.note: Final corrected long-GOP source and exact recorded production plan. Only filter-thread count and destination change between trials; actual native MP4 bytes and all trial RGB/PCM hashes match.

thread_comparison.endpoints: One warm encoder-only trial per thread count. No GOP, preset, quality or input/output thread argument is added or altered. Silent all-frame/all-sample decode hashes are recorded separately. Actual-controller timing and source preparation are separate evidence.

quality_control.scope: Raw shared renderer diagnostic without native preview GOP. Final actual-profile production references are separate mandatory gates.

seek_duration_control.scope: Preserved failed interim stress at global frame180. Input-policy-only diagnostic controls; their timings are correctness runs, not playback performance.
seek_duration_control.remedy: Retain noaccurate_seek and source timestamps; terminate main video through exact filter EOF instead of input duration. Accurate_seek failed a separate nonzero-origin regression.

before.scope: Before all three per-state reference gates; ordinary adjoining gate may already be running.

after.scope: After all four final correctness gates.

historical_settings_erratum.reason: These earlier candidates described CRF20 through the diagnostic plan, while the native job still encoded CRF22/GOP15. They are preserved and excluded; the final shared compiler plus per-asset SEI guard fixes the mismatch.
